name: math_hopf_antipode

phase_0.boundary_condition: the Hopf algebra structure H over a field K

VINIT.justification: the uninitialized state before the definition of the algebra or its underlying field

TANCH.justification: the complete closed boundary containing the unit, counit, multiplication, and comultiplication

AFWD.justification: the forward morphism acting as the identity on the algebra elements

AREV.justification: the contravariant map that reverses the order of multiplication and comultiplication

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of the identity and antipode maps within the hom-set

IMSCRIB.justification: the recognition of the antipode as an endomorphism of the algebra itself

FSPLIT.justification: the operation that branches a single element into a tensor product of two elements

FFUSE.justification: the operation that reconstitutes the original element from the tensor product via the antipode

EVALT.justification: the affirmative path where the convolution results in the unit scaled by the counit

EVALF.justification: the negative branch where an element fails to satisfy the antipode axiom

ENGAGR.justification: the state where S squared is the identity, holding both forward and reverse directions simultaneously

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of the antipode map as a defined property of the Hopf algebra

phase_3.void_description: the absence of algebraic structure or scalars
phase_3.true_description: satisfaction of the Hopf axiom mu(S tensor id)delta = unit(counit)
phase_3.false_description: failure of the antipode to invert the identity under convolution
phase_3.both_description: the antipode acting as an involution where S equals its own inverse

steps.domain_action: initialize the base field K and vector space H
identify the identity map on H
apply comultiplication to branch the element into a tensor product
apply the identity map to the first branch of the tensor
apply the antipode map to the second branch of the tensor
compose the maps through the convolution product
apply multiplication to the resulting tensor components
verify the result equals the unit scaled by the counit
record the antipode S as a fixed morphism of the structure

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the category of modules over the Hopf algebra
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the order of operations in the convolution algebra

phase_6.cycle_cost: one application of the antipode map
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: a bialgebra without a guaranteed antipode
phase_6.post_cycle_state: a Hopf algebra with a fixed antipode
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the antipode is a structure-preserving isomorphism
